limitations: Counts describe input qualification, not performance or observed travel delay.
Publisher families are not necessarily independent causal incidents; families 276882, 276899 and 276905 describe related Jay St switch problems.
Official complete-interruption notices can coexist with same-cutoff through-train forecasts; retain the warning without claiming observed physical closure.
The first-applicable fixed two-hour window is unchanged; weekday filtering does not extend a weekend event into Monday.
November 2-15 overlaps prior removed project exploration; the full reporting range is not a pristine holdout.
